## About Me

I’m a B.S. student in the Zhiyuan Honors Program in Physics Track at Shanghai Jiao Tong University (top 10% of cohort), with a minor in Computer Science.

As an AI newcomer with a background in physics, I emphasize using physical intuition and methodology to study and research AI. My current research interests lie at the intersection of AI and physics, particularly Quantum Machine Learning (QML) and Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs). I am also highly interested in multimodal generation, with a specific focus on Text-to-Speech (TTS) and image generation currently.

## Experience

I decided to switch my focus from physics to AI in June, 2025. While I have not yet published any papers, I am actively involved in several ongoing projects at the intersection of AI for Science and multimodal generation.

You can find a detailed summary of my research experience and technical skill set in my [CV](files/cv_TengyueZhang_25Nov.pdf).
